browser.ax_index_limit: accessibility index limit reached; reset Cua
browser.config_changed: browser configuration changed; reset Cua before using the new providers
browser.document_changed: document changed during observation; observe again
browser.frame_changed: frame changed during observation; observe again
browser.iframe_owner_unavailable: iframe owner occluded, transformed or detached; use a fresh tab screenshot
browser.page_not_observable: page has not reached an observable document; call getAXState again, without repeating navigation
browser.selection_ambiguous: browser selection is ambiguous or missing; select an ID from listBrowsers
browser.stale_document_cursor: stale_document: observe before showing its cursor
browser.stale_document_observe: stale_document: observe after navigation before acting
browser.stale_element_frame_detached: stale_element: frame navigated or detached; observe again
browser.stale_tab_closed_or_restarted: stale_tab: browser restarted or tab closed; bind the current tab
browser.tab_selection_ambiguous: tab selection is ambiguous or missing; choose an exact ID from listTabs
browser.unknown_outcome_suffix: ; repeating a mutation may duplicate its effects

desktop.app_selection_requires_window: App selection requires one exact open window. Bindable windows: {windows}
desktop.capture_required: capture_required: read getScreenshot before coordinate input
desktop.clipboard_changed_during_paste: Clipboard changed during paste; preserved the newer clipboard contents.
desktop.config_changed: desktop configuration changed; reset Cua before switching desktops
desktop.cursor_geometry_unavailable: native cursor element geometry unavailable; use screenshot coordinates
desktop.launch_app_ambiguous: app identity ambiguous; refresh cua.listApps before launch
desktop.launch_app_missing: app identity missing; refresh cua.listApps before launch
desktop.launch_unavailable: launch unavailable for this inventory entry; select its open window
desktop.macos_launch_interrupted: Window discovery for {app} was interrupted after launch.
desktop.macos_launch_no_window: macOS was asked to open {app}, but no window owned by that app appeared.
desktop.stale_capture: stale_capture: window changed or capture was consumed; getScreenshot again
desktop.stale_element_read_ax: stale_element: read getAXState before using this index
desktop.stale_target_process_changed: stale_target: application process ended or changed; bind it again
desktop.stale_target_window_closed: stale_target: window closed; bind a current window
desktop.window_geometry_changed: window geometry changed during capture; capture again

driver.background_unavailable: Background input is unavailable for this control on the current desktop. Use an indexed accessibility action if one is exposed by app.getAXState(); otherwise this action requires a supported desktop input backend. The public Cua API cannot switch this call to foreground delivery.
driver.terminal: Call cua_reset and rebind targets. This refused operation did not dispatch input.
driver.uncertain: The driver did not verify the requested effect; repeating the action may duplicate it.

permission.high_risk_warning: This app can expose sensitive information and perform actions on your behalf. Watch the agent while it uses the app.
permission.unknown_risk_warning: This app's risk classification has not been established. Approve access only if you trust the app and the requested work.

repl.closed: This REPL is closed. Call cua_reset and rebind targets. Dispatched input may already have taken effect.
repl.inactive: Computer Use session is inactive. Call cua_reset and rebind targets.
repl.partial_observations: Observations emitted before failure (actions may already have completed):
repl.reset: Computer Use REPL reset. Bind targets again.
